note: Realistic filled-in states in the 4AT scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result.totalScore"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade.totalScore); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: delirium-unlikely
personas.description: Fully alert, no AMT4 mistakes, months backwards correct, no acute change: 4AT 0 — delirium or severe cognitive impairment unlikely.

firedRules.description: Total 0 — delirium or severe cognitive impairment unlikely

personas.name: possible-cognitive-impairment
personas.description: Alert but one AMT4 mistake and falters on months backwards, no acute change: 4AT 2 — possible cognitive impairment, warrants further cognitive testing.

firedRules.description: AMT4 — 1 mistake across age, date of birth, place, and current year
Attention — starts months backwards but scores < 7, or refuses to start
Total 1-3 — possible cognitive impairment; further cognitive testing

flaggedIssues.description: Total 4AT score 2 of 12 (1-3) — possible cognitive impairment
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Arrange further cognitive assessment and obtain a collateral history to distinguish delirium from established cognitive impairment.

personas.name: possible-delirium
personas.description: Inattentive and untestable on AMT4 with a documented acute fluctuating change over 2 weeks: 4AT 8 — possible delirium, prompt full delirium work-up.

firedRules.description: AMT4 — 2 or more mistakes, or untestable
Attention — untestable (cannot start because unwell, drowsy, or inattentive)
Acute change or fluctuating course present over the last 2 weeks, still evident in the last 24 hours
Total 4 or more — possible delirium; prompt full clinical assessment

flaggedIssues.description: Total 4AT score 8 of 12 (4 or more) — delirium is possible, with or without cognitive impairment
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Undertake a full clinical assessment against DSM-5 / ICD-10 delirium criteria, search for precipitants, and instigate delirium management per local policy.

flaggedIssues.description: Item 4 positive — acute change or fluctuating course in alertness, cognition, or other mental function
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Treat as a strong pointer to delirium; corroborate with collateral history and review the timeline of onset and fluctuation.
